description: The code split, from the other side (issue #825): a name only a top-level BLOCK binds is NOT boundary-hidden, so a procedure reading it earns `ol-undefined-var`, not `ol-var-not-visible` (spec/error-model.md:102,132). A procedure body's only lexically enclosing scope is the root scope — a `define` is registered in phase 1 and never nested in the scope it is written in (spec/execution-model.md:651-655) — and the `repeat` body encloses no procedure body, so the boundary is not the reason this read failed. Getting it wrong in the other direction would be actively misleading: the message would offer `global temp = ...` as the fix for a name that is not a top-level name at all. The matching runtime case is tests/conformance/core-language/scoping/a-name-only-a-top-level-block-binds-is-not-boundary-hidden.
